posts.title: Having a Good Time Frequency at VCFMW21
posts.description: One of the new and exciting features we added to the VCFMW ShadyTel exhibit this year that almost no-one would have seen or realized existed was an actual high precision master frequency reference for our TDM network. This post will dig into what this device is, what it does, and why we use it. What is a Frequency Reference? The ShadyTel core network is entirely TDM, also known as Real Telephony.

posts.title: Cosplaying as a Telco: VCF Southwest 2025
